metadata.name: Adaptive Assessment Selection Evaluation
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled synthetic evaluation benchmark. Does NOT claim real student learning gains, cognitive retention, or psychometric IRT validity. Strictly measures software and algorithmic properties: candidate selection consistency, multi-signal prioritization, difficulty adaptation, repeat avoidance, language preference, provenance integrity, evidence integration, and student isolation.

scenarios.name: Low Knowledge Concept Prioritized Over Mastered Concept
scenarios.description: Concept A (Convolution) has low score (0.20) with high confidence (0.80); Concept B (LTI System) has high score (0.80) with high confidence (0.80). Concept A must receive higher priority.

scenarios.name: Explicit Uncertainty Representation and Distinction
scenarios.description: Concept A has high uncertainty (S=0.50, C=0.15) while Concept B has demonstrated weakness (S=0.30, C=0.85). Both should be prioritized, but for distinct interpretable reasons.

scenarios.name: Prerequisite Graph Importance Priority Boost
scenarios.description: Concept A (LTI System) is a prerequisite for Concept B (Convolution). When Concept B is unmastered, Concept A receives higher prerequisite relevance than Concept C (Linearity) which has no unmastered dependents.

scenarios.name: Curriculum Coverage Advantage Over Recently Assessed Concept
scenarios.description: Concept A has never been assessed (N=0); Concept B has been assessed 5 times recently (last assessed 5 minutes ago). Both have prior score 0.50. Concept A must receive coverage advantage over Concept B.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Policy-Driven Difficulty Tier Matching
scenarios.description: Verify that low knowledge state selects EASY item, developing state selects MEDIUM item, and mastered state selects HARD item.

scenarios.name: Item Repeat Avoidance Within Active Session
scenarios.description: When an item has been presented in the session, the selector selects an alternative unseen item for that concept if available.

scenarios.name: Language Preference Matching With English Fallback
scenarios.description: When student requests Telugu (te), the selector prefers Telugu items over English items when available.

scenarios.name: Academic Chunk Provenance Integrity
scenarios.description: Every selected item must retain source_chunk_ids linking back to the student's uploaded academic material.

scenarios.name: Closed-Loop Evidence Integration Into Student Knowledge Model
scenarios.description: Student response generates an EvidenceEvent (QUIZ_CORRECT or QUIZ_INCORRECT) updating KnowledgeStateService without direct state mutation by the assessment layer.

scenarios.name: Strict Multi-Student Assessment Isolation
scenarios.description: Student Alice taking assessments and building session history does not alter Student Bob's candidate ranking or seen items.
